id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

currentState.description: A stored calc field representing the current state - uses a {@link StateMachineHistory} to keep track.

stateHistories.description: A collection of the states this {@link StateMachine} has passed through.

transitions.description: Transitions available from the current state

currentStateHistory.description: Calc field to get the current state history

typeIdent.description:
Indicates explicit sub-type of entry.  Composed of the concatenation of the typeKey of the instance's type and all
of its base type's typeIdent

alertRelations.description: All the {@link ReliabilityAssetAlertToCaseRelation}s related to this case.

alerts.description:
All the {@link ReliabilityAssetAlert}s related to this case.
Represents alerts linked to this case through the alert relations.

firstAlert.description:
Reference to the most critical {@link ReliabilityAssetAlert} linked to this case.
This is the first alert in the sorted alert list.

estimatedCostOfUnplannedDowntime.description: The estimated cost in dollars ($) of unplanned downtime due to this {@link ReliabilityAssetCase}.

estimatedCostOfUnplannedMaintenance.description: The estimated cost in dollars ($) of unplanned maintenance for this {@link ReliabilityAssetCase}.

description.description: A description of the case. Readiness sets this based on alert failure mode and {@link ReliabilityAsset#functionalLocation}

numTotalAlerts.description:
Total number of alerts associated with this case.
Currently, only one alert is allowed per case.

numTotalAssets.description: Total number of assets directly linked to alerts in the case.

numFeedbacks.description: Total number of feedbacks associated with the failure modes in the case.

numWorkOrders.description: The number of work orders created for this ReliabilityAssetCase.

numOpenWorkOrders.description: The number of open work orders for this ReliabilityAssetCase that are not 'CLOSED'.

assetRelations.description:
All the {@link ReliabilityAssetCaseToAssetRelation}s related to this case.
These relations link assets to the case.

directAssets.description: All directly linked {@link ReliabilityAsset}s associated with this ReliabilityAssetCase

alertAssets.description:
All {@link ReliabilityAsset}s associated with this ReliabilityAssetCase as calculated from
this case's {@link ReliabilityAssetCase#alerts alerts}.

allAssets.description: All associated {@link ReliabilityAsset}s associated with this ReliabilityAssetCase.

subHeaderText.description: Subheader displaying case priority and its current state.

collaborators.description: List of users who have commented or are tagged in a comment on this case.

workOrders.description: All related work orders for the current case.

priority.description:
The priority assigned to the current case.
The priority value represents the case's criticality level.

priorityValue.description: The string value representing the priority of the case (P0, P1, P2).

priorityHistory.description:
Timed history of priority changes for the case.
The history is ordered by timestamp in descending order.

assignee.description: The user assigned to this ReliabilityAssetCase.

assigneeName.description: The full name or email of the user assigned to the case for UI display.

comments.description:
List of comments associated with the current case.
Comments are sorted by the most recently updated first.

latestComment.description: Latest comment associated with the current case

assigneeHistory.description:
History of user assignments to the case.
This allows tracking the change in case ownership over time.

topContributors.description:
The top 3 feature contributors for the case based on alerts.
Returns a string with names of the top 3 contributors.

latestCommentCreationTime.description:
The timestamp of the latest comment added to the case.
Used to track recent activity.

latestStateCreationTime.description: Timestamp of the latest state change for this case.

latestActivityTime.description:
The timestamp for the most recent activity on this case.
This combines the latest comment, state, priority, and assignee updates.

latestActivity.description:
A string representation of the latest activity on the case.
It can be a comment, case assignment, or priority change.

latestActivityDisplayName.description: Translates the {@link latestActivity} to a user-friendly format.

facility.description: The {@link Facility} associated with this {@link ReliabilityAssetCase}.

title:
Represents a case entity used to investigate and log issues related to a {@link ReliabilityAsset}.
A case acts as a hub for related {@link ReliabilityAssetAlert}s, {@link FailureMode}s, and {@link WorkOrder}s.

Key actions within a case include assigning it to a user, setting priorities, and collaborating on
resolution efforts through comments, failure mode reviews, and work orders. Cases help organize
investigation workflows and ensure proper tracking of asset-related issues.
name: ReliabilityAssetCase
